verification_report.summary: The complete P06.2 proof packet was checked sequentially. The new slicing proof correctly uses CLD Proposition 15.1.1(b) in the forward direction, constructs compactly supported ambient spreads of fibre tests, and justifies the continuous Fubini passage. All cited external statements and their contextual definitions were checked against theorem search, primary web sources, and the supplied/local exact source text; no mismatch or unsupported transition was found.
